type.name: Kinetic typography
type.description: A typographic rhythm study with staggered words, oversized letterforms and deliberate reading holds.
type.zhDescription: 逐词编排、超大字形与阅读停顿，让文字本身成为主角。

product.name: Product films
product.description: A product stage with a floating interface, feature focus and a clear closing message.
product.zhDescription: 用界面舞台、功能聚焦和收尾信息，展示产品价值。

phone.name: Mobile showcases
phone.description: A mobile interface reveal with layered screens and a single, readable interaction.
phone.zhDescription: 层叠屏幕、设备揭幕与可读的操作过程。

charts.name: Data in motion
charts.description: Animated bars, a readable scale and a focused data annotation.
charts.zhDescription: 让数据沿着统一刻度展开，以清楚的标注说明变化。

diagrams.name: Visual explainers
diagrams.description: A connected sequence that reveals cause, process and outcome in order.
diagrams.zhDescription: 按原因、过程、结果依次展开的图解。

shapes.name: Shape choreography
shapes.description: A geometric motion study built around form, balance and elastic timing.
shapes.zhDescription: 通过形状、平衡与弹性节奏，编排几何运动。

particles.name: Particle studies
particles.description: A seeded field of particles that gathers into a coherent orbital structure.
particles.zhDescription: 从点阵到轨道结构，展现粒子的聚合与流动。

code.name: Code stories
code.description: A terminal-inspired sequence that introduces a command and explains its result.
code.zhDescription: 围绕命令、运行过程和结果展开的开发者演示。

characters.name: Character stories
characters.description: An original geometric character scene with anticipation, action and response.
characters.zhDescription: 用原创几何角色演示预备、行动与回应。

editorial.name: Editorial motion
editorial.description: A layered editorial composition with image windows, quiet motion and strong typography.
editorial.zhDescription: 以影像窗口、克制运动和文字层级构成编辑式画面。

spatial.name: Spatial studies
spatial.description: An orbital wireframe study with depth cues and controlled camera rhythm.
spatial.zhDescription: 借助轨道、线框和节奏，表现空间深度。

audio.name: Rhythm & sound
audio.description: A rhythmic visual score with repeating bars and carefully spaced accents.
audio.zhDescription: 通过节奏条、重复与停顿，编排视觉乐章。
